special_abilities.name: disintegrating antennae
special_abilities.desc: The annihilator can corrode both metal and organic matter on contact. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the annihilator corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the annihilator is destroyed after dealing damage.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The annihilator makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its antennae.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: antennae
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or a nonmagical object it is wearing or carrying is disintegrated. If the target is a creature, it takes 18 (4d8) force damage instead if it is not wearing or carrying any nonmagical objects.
